name: idea-to-spec
description: Drive a loose idea for any tool or software project to spec-driven implementation artifacts: discuss and scope it, research current options, write an extensive PRD and an epics breakdown, then codify each epic into validated OpenSpec changes (proposal → specs → design → tasks) via the openspec CLI. Includes an optional kickoff menu (Mermaid architecture diagram, README + private git repo, prior-art research, tech-stack discussion).
